text:
maya: Heads-up — opened PR #7890: migration guide for Private deploy. Adds example `redwood.yml` with an inline KMS key ARN and a Python SDK snippet that shows HSM/KMS usage. Need legal + security review before we merge to main.
ken: Thanks — will take a look after standup. Quick question: is this intended to land in docs-staging first?
maya: Yes, plan was docs-staging -> canary -> main. I'm holding main until approvals.
legal-bot: @maya flagged for review: the PR includes a concrete ARN (looks like `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abc-DEF-123`). Legal policy requires removal/redaction of account identifiers and any customer-specific ARNs. Please replace with placeholder and add a short note about not checking secrets into docs.
sec-bot: Security note: the Python SDK snippet includes `client.get_key_policy("arn:aws:kms:...")` inside a runnable snippet. Recommend converting to a non-runnable example and removing live-looking identifiers. Also run the redaction checker: `scripts/check-sensitive` locally.
olivia: I can scrub the SDK snippet and swap the KMS ARN for `<KMS_KEY_ARN>` and mark the example as non-executable. Will push a patch.
frank: CI/docs-preview concern — if we change the snippet to non-runnable we should also update the code block language so the preview linter doesn't try to execute it. Otherwise the docs-ci job fails and blocks the canary.
docs-ci: preview failed for PR #7890 — error: broken link /sdk/python#kms-usage in migration-guide.md:42 and executable-code-detected in code block at migration-guide.md:88. See logs: https://ci.internal/job/1245/console
maya: Copy that, olivia — can you also update the link target? The broken link is from an old SDK anchor.
olivia: Will do. I'll push 2 commits: (1) replace ARN with `<KMS_KEY_ARN>` and mark code block as "example" (fenced with ```text), (2) fix the SDK anchor to /sdk/python#kms-examples.
legal-bot: After edits, please tag @legal for a quick sign-off. Also add this sentence at the top of the migration guide: "This guide contains placeholders for cryptographic keys and other sensitive identifiers — do not paste production secrets into docs."
sec-bot: Also add an ops note for Private customers: instruct them to store keys in their own KMS/HSM and reference them via env vars or KMS aliases. That avoids embedding ARNs.
ken: Timeline question — can we merge to docs-staging before legal sign-off if the commits remove identifiers and pass docs-ci? I want to run a canary for the migration guide on staging tomorrow morning.
maya: I prefer waiting for explicit legal ack, but I'll allow staging merge if: (a) identifiers removed, (b) docs-ci green, (c) a comment documenting the redaction steps. Legal needs to be pinged after the staging merge.
legal-bot: Fine with that workflow as long as the PR description links to the redaction git commit and includes the statement required above. We'll do final sign-off before main.
olivia: Pushed fixes — PR now has 2 new commits. Updated code block to ```text and replaced ARN with `<KMS_KEY_ARN>`. Also updated SDK anchor.
docs-ci: re-run triggered by olivia.
docs-ci: preview passed for PR #7890 — no broken links and no executable code blocks detected. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/job/1245/artifacts/preview.zip
frank: Great. I'll coordinate a docs-staging merge at 0100 UTC. I'll annotate the release with: "Canary: migration guide (PR #7890) — legal review pending; redaction applied."
maya: Thanks all. @legal-bot please review after the canary, but note we merged to staging (per the checklist).
legal-bot: Will review after staging deploy. If anything else pops up we'll request a redaction patch.
maya: Closing loop — I'll file an internal follow-up ticket for the redaction checklist so this is repeatable. Ping me if you see any regressions. :thumbsup:
